Where to stay with your four-legged companion on the San Francisco Peninsula

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:20
Instaread

Traveling with your pet has never been easier or more enjoyable on the San Francisco Peninsula. From sleek, design-forward hotels in the heart of Silicon Valley to cozy coastal retreats along Half Moon Bay, there’s no shortage of welcoming places to stay. Whether you’re planning a weekend escape or an extended visit, these dog-friendly properties make it simple to bring your pet along for the experience.

Stylish Stays on the Bayside/Silicon Valley

For those seeking a more refined, urban stay, Four Seasons Hotel Silicon Valley at East Palo Alto offers a sophisticated experience with thoughtful accommodations for guests traveling with pets. With its polished design and proximity to major tech hubs, it’s an ideal choice for combining business and leisure—without leaving your pet behind.

Nearby, Grand Bay Hotel San Francisco provides a scenic, waterside setting that’s especially appealing for pet owners. Overlooking a tranquil lagoon, the hotel offers plenty of space for walks and fresh air just steps from your room. It’s a convenient and comfortable base for exploring Redwood City and the surrounding Peninsula.

Another great option is Residence Inn Redwood City San Carlos, which caters well to longer stays. With spacious suites and a relaxed atmosphere, it’s a practical choice for travelers who want a bit more room to settle in with their pet.

Adding a more modern airport-adjacent luxury option, the Grand Hyatt at SFO stands out for its sleek design, soundproof comfort, and seamless access to travel. It’s an especially convenient choice for pet owners in transit who still want an elevated hotel experience.

Coastal Escapes in Half Moon Bay

If your ideal getaway includes ocean views and fresh coastal air, Half Moon Bay delivers. The Ritz-Carlton, Half Moon Bay stands out as one of the most luxurious pet-friendly options on the Peninsula. In addition to its dramatic cliffside setting and world-class amenities, the hotel offers thoughtful perks for pets—and even donates a portion of pet fees to a local animal shelter, adding a meaningful touch to your stay.

Beyond luxury resorts, Half Moon Bay is also home to a variety of charming, pet-friendly inns and cottages that provide a more intimate, relaxed experience. These smaller accommodations are perfect for travelers looking to unwind, explore nearby beaches, and enjoy the slower pace of the coast with their pets.

Convenient Stays Near SFO Airport & Bay Access

For travelers prioritizing convenience, accessibility, and easy outdoor access, the South San Francisco and Oyster Point area offers several excellent pet-friendly options.

Embassy Suites San Francisco Airport Oyster Point is a popular choice for pet owners thanks to its proximity to waterfront walking areas around Oyster Point. The surrounding paths offer a peaceful setting for daily walks, making it especially convenient for longer stays with pets.

Larkspur Landing Extended Stay Suites South San Francisco is ideal for guests planning extended visits. With suite-style rooms and a relaxed atmosphere, it offers a practical and comfortable home base for travelers with pets.

Just along the shoreline, Embassy Suites San Francisco Airport Waterfront provides easy access to the Bay Trail, one of the most scenic and dog-friendly walking routes in the region. It’s a great option for guests who want direct access to outdoor recreation right outside their door.

For a modern, budget-friendly stay, Home2 Suites by Hilton San Francisco Airport North offers flexible accommodations designed with longer stays in mind. Its location makes it easy to access nearby parks, trails, and waterfront paths for daily walks with your pet.

A Welcoming Destination for You and Your Pet

What makes the Peninsula especially appealing is how seamlessly pet-friendly lodging integrates with the surrounding environment. Many hotels are located near walking paths, parks, or coastal trails, making it easy to incorporate outdoor time into your stay. Whether you’re strolling along the waterfront in Redwood City or taking in ocean views in Half Moon Bay, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to explore the Peninsula with your pet.

Before booking, it’s always a good idea to review each property’s pet policy, including any size restrictions or fees. With a little planning, you can ensure a smooth and enjoyable stay for both you and your pet.

From modern luxury to coastal charm, the San Francisco Peninsula offers a range of pet-friendly accommodations that make traveling with your furry companion feel effortless and memorable.
